# Anderson Maik Rodrigues

> Senior Software Engineer at Nubank specializing in Clojure, Java, and High-Scale Distributed Systems.

## Core Summary
Anderson Rodrigues is a Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience designing, architecting, and operating scalable backend services, event-driven microservices, and financial transaction processing systems. Currently at Nubank, he works on credit and payment platforms processing millions of transactions, focusing on Clojure, functional programming, and distributed systems resilience.

## Primary Technical Expertise
- **Languages:** Clojure, Java (6-21+), Functional Programming, SQL
- **Architecture & Systems:** Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, API-Driven Development, Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
- **Frameworks & Tools:** Spring Boot, Quarkus, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, REST APIs, OAuth
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Circuit Breakers, Observability, Caching
- **AI & Automation:** AI-assisted engineering workflows, internal agentic diagnostic & investigation tools

## Work History
1. **Nubank** (April 2024 – Present)
   - *Role:* Senior Software Engineer (August 2026 – Present), Software Engineer (April 2024 – August 2026)
   - *Focus:* Post-Purchase Financing, NuPay Credit and Payment Conditions, automated financial refund workflows, Credit Awareness & Merchants Hub.
   - *Impact:* Built reusable installment financing infrastructure for purchases up to 12 installments; automated interest and tax refund calculations for financing reversals; developed BDC (Backend-Driven Content) APIs contributing to a 68% conversion increase for NuPay; built an internal AI-assisted diagnostic tool for incident resolution.

2. **Avenue Code** (January 2022 – April 2024)
   - *Role:* Software Engineer / Tech Lead
   - *Focus:* High-traffic Java microservices, Spring Boot, AWS, Tech Leadership, A/B testing & feature flagging platform.
   - *Impact:* Reduced system downtime by 40% and improved API response times by 25%. Led cross-functional engineering teams.

3. **NTT DATA Europe & LATAM** (April 2021 – January 2022)
   - *Role:* Software Engineer
   - *Focus:* Real-time transaction categorization, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Java, Spring Boot, AWS.
   - *Impact:* Reduced transaction processing latency by 35% across pipelines handling millions of daily bank transactions.

4. **APECATUS** (February 2020 – April 2021)
   - *Role:* Senior Software Engineer
   - *Focus:* LMS platform capabilities using Java, Quarkus, Angular, and AWS cloud architecture.
   - *Impact:* Delivered 5+ major product releases and reduced page load times by 50%.

5. **Idealogic Software** (June 2015 – February 2020)
   - *Role:* Software Engineer (Progressed from Junior to Senior)
   - *Focus:* ERP, CRM, enterprise software automation with Java, Spring, Struts 2, AWS.
   - *Impact:* Delivered 10+ production systems, automating manual workflows by up to 80%.
